create_selfchatworld: create a SelfChatWorld instance with agents and options for self-chat dialogue episodes
load_openers_from_task: load conversation openers from a ParlAI task dataset using the load_openers function
load_openers_from_file: load conversation openers from a text file using the load_openers_from_file function
override_get_contexts: override the get_contexts method in SelfChatWorld to seed episodes with custom context messages
override_get_openers: override the get_openers method in SelfChatWorld to return custom opening messages for episodes
